sanskrit_verse: क्षेत्रिकानुमतं बीजं यस्य क्षेत्रे प्रमुच्यते । तदपत्यं द्वयोरेव बीजिक्षेत्रिकयोर्मतम् ॥
transliteration: kṣetrikānumataṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre pramucyate | tadapatyaṃ dvayor eva bījikṣetrikayor mataṃ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The child born from seed approved by the field-owner, within his field, is lawfully attributed to both the seed-giver and the field-owner.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority over the domain determines relational accountability
Capacity-based responsibility is shared proportionally among enabling agents
Restoration logic requires acknowledgment of contributory roles
Consciousness alignment necessitates truthful attribution of origin
executable_legal_axioms: IF a child is conceived using seed with explicit permission of the landholder THEN legal parentage includes both seed-provider and landholder
IF conception occurs in a domain without owner's consent THEN no legal claim by domain owner EXISTS
IF either party withdraws consent prior to gestation completion THEN their legal attribution ceases AUTOMATICALLY
ALL claims must align with factual causality AND conscious assent at time of action
Responsibility is NON-TRANSFERABLE and RESTORABLE only through voluntary reintegration
supreme_court_application: In matters of parental rights or inheritance involving assisted reproduction or surrogate contexts, the court shall recognize dual attribution where both biological contribution and territorial consent are present. The threshold for legal parentage includes not just genetic origin but also the sanctioned use of the reproductive domain. Retributive frameworks hold no place; restoration lies in accurate recognition of all contributing parties.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse establishes pramāṇa-based causality wherein both seed and soil contribute sequentially and substantially to the outcome. Responsibility flows from capacity to enable, not from fault or wrongdoing. There is no punitive element—only precise alignment of relational integrity based on actual participation and conscious agreement.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: All involved parties affirm their role in the creation and assume proportional guardianship duties
Assumption Protocol: Legal identity of offspring reflects acknowledged contributions without erasure or falsification
Capacity Restoration: Any disruption in familial harmony is addressed via guided realignment rather than adjudicated separation
Integrity Reintegration: Where denial or misattribution has occurred, correction is made through mutual disclosure and conscious reaffirmation
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is restored through rightful attribution. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
